title: Match capitals: South-eastern Asia
intro: Match each country in South-eastern Asia with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Phnom Penh is the capital of Cambodia.
Vientiane is the capital of Lao People's Democratic Republic.
Naypyidaw is the capital of Myanmar.
Kuala Lumpur is the capital of Malaysia.
Singapore is the capital of Singapore.
Bangkok is the capital of Thailand.
Dili is the capital of Timor-Leste.
Hanoi is the capital of Viet Nam.
